events.title: Telegram
events.text:
A Florida fishing charter hauled a Shahed-136 clone drone out of the Gulf of Mexico near Eglin Air Force Base.
Eglin confirmed it lost a drone during testing but wouldn't confirm it was the same one.
The recovered drone matches the FLM-136/LUCAS — America's own reverse-engineered copy of Iran's Shahed-136, which costs ~$35K per unit and saw first combat use striking Iran.
It was missing its engine, propeller, and nose cone from the water impact.
[SOURCE](https://www.twz.com/air/shahed-136-clone-found-by-florida-fisherman-eglin-afb-admits-it-lost-a-drone)

🇮🇱🔯 Israeli politician demands Nazi-style collective punishment for residents of Palestinian village
 
In 1942, a pair of Czechoslovak commandos assassinated Reinhard Heydrich, second-in-command of the SS and one of the principal architects of the Final Solution. In response, the Nazis razed two Czech villages to the ground, executed all their adult male residents and some women, and deported the remaining women and children to concentration camps.
84 years on, former Netanyahu foreign and defense minister Avigdor Liberman is calling for something similar in the West Bank.
“We must impose a heavy cost – there is no forgiveness for terrorism,” Liberman tweeted Sunday, shortly after a deadly shooting near the illegal settlement of Neve Tzuf in the West Bank, in which a settler was killed by a Palestinian man from the nearby village of Biddu.
🔊“The IDF must enter the village from which the terrorist came from and raze it,” Liberman demanded.
 
Falling out with Netanyahu in 2018 amid a clash of egos and charges that Bibi was “coddling” Hamas, Liberman currently positions himself as perhaps the most fascistic hardliner in Israeli politics, outdoing even frothing radicals in Netanyahu’s cabinet like Itamar [Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74827).
Liberman’s Yisrael Beytenu is expected to win 8-11 seats in the next parliament after October’s elections. While this isn’t nearly enough to return him to government as PM, it could give him the role of kingmaker, as Netanyahu’s bloc and the opposition are locked in a neck-and-neck tie (estimated at 53-54 seats each -below the 61-seat threshold for forming a government).
Netanyahu being too ‘soft’ on Israel’s enemies – now there’s an image. What would Liberman do if he was in charge? Just [nuke everyone](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/56811), Samson Option-style?

events.text:
🇨🇳📊 China may be building world's first mothership for giant underwater drones
Satellite imagery shows a roughly 200-meter-long vessel under construction at the Hudong-Zhonghua shipyard in Shanghai — apparently designed to carry, launch, and recover full-size uncrewed submarines, according to Chinese media.
What makes the apparent mothership remarkable:
🔶 The vessel features a large internal hangar that could accommodate up to four top-secret giant underwater drones
🔶The mothership has a stern well-deck with a 12-arm lifting cradle for launching and recovering them
🔶 The ship is designed around extra-extra-large uncrewed underwater vehicles (XXLUUVs) up to 45 m long — essentially submarine-sized autonomous drones, about twice the size of the US Navy's Orca XXLUUVs
🔶 The Chinese XXLUUVs could potentially have a range of around 10,000 nautical miles
China has already been testing these giant underwater drones from specialized floating docks, which allow them to be transported offshore and launched for trials.
A dedicated mothership, however, could take the concept much further — providing a mobile platform for deployment, recovery, and maintenance far from shore. In effect, it could turn the XXLUUV from an experimental system into a long-range operational asset.

🔥🚨 US backs away from offensive strikes on Houthis — report
🗣The Trump administration made it clear that they have little interest in using the US military to stop the Houthis, relying instead on Saudi Arabia to do so, CNN reports.
🔊"No offensive strikes [on Houthi fighters in Yemen]," an unnamed US official warned.
The US believes Saudi Arabia is receiving everything it needs to counter the Houthis, another official noted, citing the recent expansion of intelligence sharing of targeting data.
Earlier, the Lebanese broadcaster Al Mayadeen reported that Saudi Arabia was seeking to reach an agreement with the Houthis through intermediaries.
Tensions escalated in Yemen in July after pro-government forces struck Sanaa airport as an Iranian plane carrying Houthi leaders was landing. The Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia and declared war on Riyadh, demanding an end to the blockade and compensation for wartime damage. 
Since then, the Houthis have advanced along the western coast, seizing areas near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, including the key port of Al-Mokha.
